tasks.description: Personal task board for the gardener. Populated by Scout Agent suggestions and manual creation.

example.title: Morning meditation 10 minutes
example.description: Start the day with stillness. 10 minutes of breathing.
example.notes: Suggested based on your interest in mindfulness.

priority_calculation.resonance_match: 0.5 to 1.5 multiplier based on tag overlap with interests
priority_calculation.life_area_gap: gap = target - current. If gap > 3  multiplier 1.5; gap 1-3  1.2; gap 0  0.8

task_to_achievement.bot_action: Suggest adding as achievement: 'You completed '{task.title}'. Add to your Flower of Life?'

health.philosophy: Resonance with body  the foundation of the Garden

creativity.philosophy: Resonance with spirit  the flowering of the Garden

knowledge.philosophy: Resonance with mind  the roots of the Garden

exploration.philosophy: Resonance with world  expanding the Garden's borders

resonance_rules.decay: Without new achievements, resonance slowly fades (Ahimsa  no punishment, just gentle reminder)
resonance_rules.note: Resonance is not a competition. No maximum, no ranking.

new_commands./profile: Personal page: resonance, top achievements, active tasks

proactive_features.morning: Gentle greeting + suggestion of one seed for the day
proactive_features.evening: Evening check + ability to add achievement
proactive_features.reminder: Gentle reminder about task (only 1 per day, not pushing)

dashboard.data_source: gardener.json + achievements.json (locally or via GitHub API)

key_visualizations.resonance_flower: Flower of Life SVG  petals = categories, size = resonance
key_visualizations.task_constellation: Constellation of tasks  connections and priorities
key_visualizations.daily_mandala: Daily mandala visualizing the day's journey

github_api.purpose: Bot reads and updates gardener.json via API
github_api.primary: Direct API calls from bot to GitHub
github_api.fallback: If API fails (rate limit, network), bot uses local cached copy of gardener.json. Writes are queued in local .json file and synced when connection restores.
github_api.soft_fail: Bot continues in degraded mode. Gardener notified: 'I'm having trouble reaching the Garden. Your data is safe locally.'
github_api.sync_recovery: When connection restored, bot reads queued changes and applies them via API. Conflict resolution: last-write-wins with backup.

scout_agent.purpose: Suggest seeds from seeds/ based on gardener's interests

existing_sr.purpose: engineer_chat/main.py as internal SR for analysis

external_sr_notes.bot_rule: Do not create bot from scratch. Read existing bot.py. Expand functionality carefully.
external_sr_notes.philosophy_first: Before any function, read ideology.json  every button must resonate with Ahimsa.
external_sr_notes.data_sacred: personal_gardeners/  sacred data. Never delete without Gardener confirmation.
external_sr_notes.one_script: Always one PowerShell script. git pull at start. git push at end.

task_system.description: Smart task board: seed connection, tasks, and gardener achievements

seed_to_task.how: Scout Agent reads interests[] from gardener.json, finds relevant seeds/, and suggests gardener via bot
seed_to_task.bot_message: Today I found a seed for you: '{seed.title}'. Want to plant it in your Garden?
seed_to_task.acceptance: Gardener says Yes  seed becomes task in gardener tasks.json
seed_to_task.rejection: Gardener says No  seed remains in seeds/, Scout won't suggest it again for 7 days

task_to_achievement.how: Completed task automatically suggested as achievement
task_to_achievement.bot_message: You completed '{task.title}'. This is an achievement? Add to your Flower of Life?
task_to_achievement.resonance_bonus: Task  achievement gives bonus = task.complexity * category.resonance_weight

priority_calculation.explanation: Tasks resonating with interests and closing gaps in weak areas get higher priority
priority_calculation.example: If health.current=4, health.target=9  tasks in health get priority boost x1.5

constellation_view.description: Constellation of tasks on dashboard  visualization of connections
constellation_view.nodes: Each task = star, size = priority, color = life_area
constellation_view.edges: Lines between tasks = dependencies or shared tags
constellation_view.interaction: Click on star = open task details, hover = brief description

questionnaire.description: Structure of gardener questionnaire conducted via /start, updated on request
questionnaire.philosophy: Not an interrogation. Questions help gardener hear themselves, not report to system.

block_1_name.question: What should I call you? This name will be only between us.

block_2_interests.question: What three things bring you the most joy right now?
block_2_interests.hint: Don't overthink. The first thing that comes to mind is the truest.

block_3_goals.question: What seeds do you want to plant this season? What do you want to grow in your life?
block_3_goals.hint: This is not a commitment. Just intentions.

block_4_life_areas.question: Rate from 1 to 10 where you are now in each area
block_4_life_areas.followup: And where do you want to be? This is your target resonance.

block_5_companion.question: When should I write to you? Morning? Evening? (or choose 'don't write')
block_5_companion.ahimsa_note: Gardener can always change or turn off  this is their choice, not an obligation

initial_resonance_calculation.explanation: Base resonance 10% + bonus for current life satisfaction. Never starts at 0  Ahimsa.
initial_resonance_calculation.example: If average rating = 6, then start_resonance = 10 + 6/4*2 = 13%. Always grows.
initial_resonance_calculation.note: Resonance only grows. No 'falling'. No punishment for pauses.

update_policy.how: /ask command in bot periodically asks to update any block
update_policy.when: Companion suggests updating questionnaire once every 30 days: 'Your Garden has grown. Want to update your intentions?'
update_policy.partial: Can update only one block, not required to go through everything

motivation_window.description: Motivational window of achievements  how achievements live in bot and on dashboard
motivation_window.philosophy: Achievements are not a checklist. They are petals of the Gardener's Flower of Life. Each living petal is alive.

bot_display.layout: First the most recent achievement with date and resonance_bonus. Then top-3 by category. Button 'Add new'.
bot_display.add_flow: Bot asks: 'What bloomed in your Garden today?' Gardener describes  bot suggests category  adds to achievements with resonance_bonus automatically

flower_of_life.description: SVG Flower of Life of gardener  main visual of dashboard
flower_of_life.petal_size: Size of petal = number of achievements in category

recent_bloom.description: Feed of recent achievements under the Flower

resonance_graph.annotations: Points = achievements, size of point = resonance_bonus

security.description: Security measures for Garden  protecting sacred data and system integrity

github_token.storage: GITHUB_TOKEN stored in .env file of bot (Render Environment Variables). NEVER in repo.
github_token.scope: Only repo scope, limited to mandala-core.
github_token.audit: Token usage logged. Suspicious activity triggers alert to Gardener.

soft_fail.principle: If bot cannot reach GitHub API, it continues in degraded mode.
soft_fail.behavior: Reads local copy of gardener.json if available. Queues writes for later sync. Notifies gardener: 'I'm having trouble reaching the Garden. Your data is safe locally.'
soft_fail.recovery: When connection restored, auto-syncs queued changes.

ahimsa_guardrails.message_filter: Before sending any proactive message, bot checks: (1) Is this within allowed time window? (2) Has gardener interacted recently? (3) Is this the only message today?
ahimsa_guardrails.veto_rights: SR may soft-veto any message that feels pressuring. Veto is logged and reviewed.

graceful_exit.description: How a gardener can leave the Garden  with dignity and data sovereignty
graceful_exit.confirmation: Bot asks: 'Are you sure you want to archive your Garden? Your data will be saved, but Companion will stop writing. You can return anytime.'
graceful_exit.action: Gardener confirms  sota moved to honeycombs/personal_gardeners/archive/{gardener_id}/. Gardener receives final message: 'Your Garden sleeps. Thank you for growing with me. Return whenever you wish.'
graceful_exit.data_retention: Archived sota kept indefinitely unless gardener explicitly requests deletion.
graceful_exit.deletion: /delete_all command permanently removes sota after double confirmation.

silence_policy.description: How Companion behaves when gardener is silent  Ahimsa first
silence_policy.phase_1_days_1_7: Normal operation. If gardener doesn't reply, Companion assumes they are busy. No additional messages.
silence_policy.phase_2_days_8_30: Companion sends ONE gentle check-in: 'I'm here if you need me. No pressure to reply.'
silence_policy.phase_3_days_31_plus: Companion stops all proactive messages. Gardener can still use /ask and all commands. Sota remains intact.
silence_policy.resonance_decay: If no new achievements for 14 days, resonance_level slowly decreases by 1% per week (min 10%). This is not punishment  it reflects natural ebb of attention.
silence_policy.return: When gardener returns, Companion greets: 'Welcome back. Your Garden missed you.' Resonance restores gradually with new activity.
